newsitem.title: INDIA: Profit-taking in Reliance pulls down Delhi shares.
newsitem.headline: Profit-taking in Reliance pulls down Delhi shares.

text.p: Delhi share prices closed lower in volatile trade on Tuesday as speculators and institutional investors booked profits in Reliance Industries, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 2.64 points lower at 789.90.
Reliance Industries declared its annual results for 1996/97 (April-March). The company's net profit rose to 13.23 billion rupees in 1996/97 from 13.05 billion a year earlier.
The petrochemicals giant said its sales rose to 87.3 billion rupees from 77.86 billion in the previous year. It also announced a dividend of 6.50 rupees per share compared with six rupees last year.
